messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking multivitamins, mineral supplements, or antacids"
set: ["consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking multivitamins, mineral supplements, or antacids", "consult doctor or pharmacist about safety", "consult doctor or pharmacist before taking medicines that can raise blood pressure", "consult doctor or pharmacist if unsure whether medication is an MAOI", "check with your doctor or pharmacist before combining medicines", "ask a doctor or pharmacist before using medicines for pain, fever, swelling, or cold/flu symptoms", "consult doctor or pharmacist if using without prescription and have medical conditions", "inform doctor or pharmacist if taking other heart or blood pressure medications", "inform doctor or pharmacist if pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding", "inform doctor or pharmacist about all medications currently taken or recently stopped taking", "ask doctor before taking NSAID", "call your doctor or pharmacist for advice if taking once every other day or following a taper", "make liquid before taking or giving it", "consult doctor before changing alcohol consumption if drinking regularly", "ask your doctor or pharmacist first if you need a painkiller", "tell your doctor or pharmacist if you have a latex allergy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
